inplace.old:
**Verification.** Before any number enters the paper, an independent session recomputes the H1 contrasts and the
Table I columns from the raw run directories (Amendment A10: `framelease_v4/analysis/verify_independent.py`
recomputes DS, SR, RC, collisions/km and infractions/km; a second script, registered by its own amendment before
the analysis freeze, recomputes the other Table I columns, which enter the paper once its result is entered in
Sec. 13).
